authority: The exponent-separator property is "E" here, so "$" and the trailing position are passive. XPath 3.1 F&O 4.7.4: "The suffix is set to contain all passive characters to the right of the rightmost active character in the sub-picture". 1.3 rounds to 1 at maximum-fractional-part-size 0 and the decimal-separator is removed because no digits follow it (F&O 4.7.5).
